title: 15 August 2009: Paul McCartney live at Piedmont Park, Atlanta
content:
Paul McCartney performed at Piedmont Park in Atlanta, Georgia, USA, on 15 August 2009.

It was the eighth show of the Summer Live ’09 Tour, which lasted for 10 dates in July and August 2009. This show was seen by 36,062 fans.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

  • ‘Jet’
  • ‘Only Mama Knows’
  • ‘Flaming Pie’
  • ‘Got To Get You Into My Life’
  • ‘Let Me Roll It’
  • ‘Highway’
  • ‘The Long And Winding Road’

  • ‘Yesterday’

Summer Live ’09 Tour dates

  • 18 July 2009: Citi Field, New York City, USA
